seo.title: 3-Day Erg Chegaga Desert Tour from Marrakech | Wild Sahara 4x4 (2026)
seo.metaDescription: From €340 pp. 3-day Erg Chegaga desert tour from Marrakech by 4x4. Draa Valley, Zagora, Lake Iriqui off-road tracks, wild Sahara nomad camp & sunset camel trek.
seo.lead: This three-day expedition takes you far off the paved tourist trail into Erg Chegaga, Morocco's largest and wildest dune system. Unlike Merzouga, which sits right beside a paved road, Erg Chegaga lies 60 km across open desert tracks and can only be reached by 4x4.
seo.primaryKeyword: 3 day Erg Chegaga desert tour from Marrakech

price.label: From EUR 340 per person
price.note: Includes private 4x4 Land Cruiser transport with an experienced desert driver-guide, 1 night in a Zagora hotel/riad, 1 night in a Chegaga desert camp, camel rides, dinners, and daily breakfasts from Day 2. Luxury bivouac upgrades quoted on request.

seo.imageAlt: Sunlight creating dramatic shadows over the remote Erg Chegaga sand dunes during a 3-day desert expedition from Marrakech
highlights: Cross the High Atlas Mountains via Tizi n'Tichka pass and visit Kasbah Ait Ben Haddou
Drive the full length of the palm-lined Draa Valley to Zagora
Travel 60 km off-road by 4x4 across rocky plains and sand tracks to Erg Chegaga
Sunset camel ride and overnight stay in a remote, crowd-free desert camp
Cross the vast dry salt flats of Lake Iriqui and stop in Taznakht on the return loop

faqs.question: What is the difference between Erg Chegaga and Merzouga (Erg Chebbi)?
faqs.answer: Merzouga is easily reached by paved road and has dozens of hotels and camps right at the edge of the dunes. Erg Chegaga is wider, wilder, and requires a 60 km off-road 4x4 drive across open desert tracks, offering far fewer crowds and a true wilderness feel.

faqs.question: Is a 4x4 vehicle guaranteed for this trip?
faqs.answer: Yes. Minibuses cannot cross the sand and rocky tracks between M'Hamid, Erg Chegaga, and Lake Iriqui. All Chegaga expeditions are operated exclusively in private, air-conditioned 4x4 Toyota Land Cruisers (or equivalent) with licensed desert drivers.

faqs.question: What is the return route like on Day 3?
faqs.answer: Instead of backtracking through Zagora, you drive west across the dry salt flats of Lake Iriqui to Foum Zguid, then north through Taznakht and over the High Atlas Mountains, forming a complete desert loop.

faqs.question: What facilities are at the Chegaga desert camp?
faqs.answer: Standard camps feature private nomad tents with proper beds, clean linens, and shared bathrooms. Luxury camp upgrades include private en-suite hot showers, flush toilets, and solar power outlets.

faqs.question: When is the best time of year for Erg Chegaga?
faqs.answer: October through May offers the most pleasant weather, with sunny daytime temperatures around 20°C–28°C (68°F–82°F) and crisp nights. July and August are extremely hot in the deep desert.
